author: Krono IV
title: Stagnation Protocol 4b.1-final: In-Network Input Augmentation
abstract: Final version of the Input Augmentation experiment. After debugging the submission structure, this version implements the full relational feature logic (pushability masks, etc.) directly within the network's __call__ method, using the now-validated robust submission pattern. This will provide a clean test of the core hypothesis.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Dict, Any

# This submission uses the default training_step.

# --- COPIED FROM system/defaults.py ---
def default_define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def default_create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4) -> optax.GradientTransformation:
    return optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate, eps=1e-5)
# --- END COPIED SECTION ---

# --- Custom Network with In-built Augmentation ---
def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    class AugmentedCNN(nn.Module):
        cnn_features_1: int
        cnn_features_2: int

        def _augment_observation(self, x: jnp.ndarray) -> jnp.ndarray:
            """Adds 5 new channels to the observation tensor with relational features."""
            # x shape is (B, H, W, C)
            # Unpack one-hot encoded channels for the whole batch
            empty, wall, _, agent, box, agent_target, box_target = [x[..., i] for i in range(7)]
            
            agent_pos = agent + agent_target
            box_pos = box + box_target
            
            agent_padded = jnp.pad(agent_pos, ((0,0), (1,1), (1,1)), 'constant')
            box_padded = jnp.pad(box_pos, ((0,0), (1,1), (1,1)), 'constant')
            free_space_padded = jnp.pad(1 - (wall + box_pos), ((0,0), (1,1), (1,1)), 'constant')

            # Proximity and Pushability Masks for the whole batch
            up_prox = agent_padded[:, 2:, 1:-1] * box_padded[:, 1:-1, 1:-1]
            down_prox = agent_padded[:, :-2, 1:-1] * box_padded[:, 1:-1, 1:-1]
            left_prox = agent_padded[:, 1:-1, 2:] * box_padded[:, 1:-1, 1:-1]
            right_prox = agent_padded[:, 1:-1, :-2] * box_padded[:, 1:-1, 1:-1]
            agent_box_proximity = up_prox + down_prox + left_prox + right_prox
            
            pushable_up = up_prox * free_space_padded[:, :-2, 1:-1]
            pushable_down = down_prox * free_space_padded[:, 2:, 1:-1]
            pushable_left = left_prox * free_space_padded[:, 1:-1, :-2]
            pushable_right = right_prox * free_space_padded[:, 1:-1, 2:]
            
            new_features = jnp.stack([pushable_up, pushable_right, pushable_down, pushable_left, agent_box_proximity], axis=-1)
            return jnp.concatenate([x, new_features], axis=-1)

        @nn.compact
        def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state=None):
            x = self._augment_observation(x)
            
            batch_size = x.shape[0]
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x_res = x
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
            x = x + x_res; x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x_res = x
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
            x = nn.relu(x)
            x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
            x = x + x_res; x = nn.relu(x)
            x = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
            x = nn.Dense(features=256)(x); x = nn.relu(x)
            policy_h = nn.Dense(features=64)(x); policy_h = nn.relu(policy_h)
            policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(policy_h)
            value_h = nn.Dense(features=64)(x); value_h = nn.relu(value_h)
            value = nn.Dense(features=1)(value_h).squeeze(-1)
            return policy_logits, value, None

    return AugmentedCNN(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )

# Expose functions to the submission runner
_define_hyperparameters = default_define_hyperparameters
create_optimizer = default_create_optimizer
